intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Nerelle folds her arms on the edge and listens to the water against the stone. She says nothing.

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: You say nothing too. It gets very quiet.

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “Eleven seconds. You are doing very well.”

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “Surface people seem to fear pauses. The best a merchant has managed is seven seconds. Then he told me about his knees.”

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “The current talks more when nobody interrupts it.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: You say nothing. The water says a good deal. After a while, Nerelle nods, as if the current has made a fair point.

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “Forty-one seconds. I will have to tell the merchant.”

options.labelText: “Don’t overthink it. Go with your gut. They need an answer.”

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “My gut does not sit on the council.”

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “Also, you only lasted four seconds that time.”
